items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: Marty was interviewed via Zoom on May 9, 2022 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Marty was interviewed via Zoom on May 9, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and boy am I pleased to have Marty Sheller with me today. Mr. Sheller, welcome, and congratulations on your career.
